speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
text: asked the Minister for Health what can be done to support public hospitals to attract and retain pharmacy technicians.

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
text: asked the Minister for Health what financial support can be given to public hospitals to allow them to offer competitive salaries to pharmacy technicians.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: We will review the PharmTech CDP regularly and raise public awareness of the career and professional development opportunities for pharmacy technicians.
